title: Integrated English I: Main Exam, 18 August 2021

instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Using relevant examples, highlight three types of sentence.
With clear examples, highlight types of conjunctions.
Give four examples of collective nouns.
What kinds of relationships do prepositions establish in sentence construction?
Give any four types of nouns.
The sentences below are ungrammatical. Underline the error and rewrite the sentences correctly.
Either cars or a bus are useful for the trip.
The voters with the candidate was disappointed.
A cup of tea or glass of milk is good for you.
Differentiate subject and predicate and provide a relevant example.

items.text: Write four sentences for each pattern below. i) S.V.O. ii) S.V.A. iii) S.V.O.O. iv) S.V.O.C. v) S.V.O.A.

parts.text: Identify and explain any five types of phrases using relevant examples.
Using relevant examples, differentiate inflectional and derivational morphemes.

items.text: Write short notes on the following. i) Free and bound morphemes. ii) Stem, root and base. iii) Open and closed words. iv) Allomorph.
